assertions.name: S_equals_h_times_D_signflip_in_D
assertions.source: S=h*D(u): h anchor-blind, D=S/h sign-flips (muon>0>proton) => sign-flip is in the bar-even ladder D(u), consistent with the 1/u^3 extraction (#3636)

description: Bridge (c₃-wall capstone items 2+3): connects the Φ_b state-integral results (#3654: deficit 0.0094, finite-b i·t·κ₁=0.058) to the corpus's bar-even/odd ladder log R=E(u)+h·D(u), h=q−1/q, E,D∈ℚ(√3). S=h·D(u): h is anchor-blind (~0.209), D=S/h is +0.0463 (muon)/−0.1887 (proton) — the sign-flip lives in the bar-even ladder D(u), carried to c₃ by the 1/u³ extraction (merged #3636). Clarifies the #3654 framing: the bar-odd part is h·ℚ(√3), NOT a separate ℚ(√−3) channel (√−3 is the geometric cusp modulus, not the ladder's home). The exact-normalization gap = the exact ladder D(u) (corpus even/odd-channel program), which the state integral meets only at the scale. No re-derivation of the ladder; bridge only. Scope-(a); C14; no c_k wired; no fit.
